CLASSIFICATION/OPERATOR CONCERN, extending carried_sentinels_v2 (both v2-carried findings on this row: the WEP2-vs-Phase-I misattribution check and the Operator/Owner misattribution risk 'extending batch_03's finding...to these five rows [P4793-P4797/P5861], which were outside that fan-out's scope') with concrete NEW documentary evidence this run. (1) OPERATOR/OWNER: a 2022 CCXI credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (http://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf, verified live, names 西气东输二线 and 管道分公司 directly) states Jiangxi has exactly two provincial long-distance gas operators, split cleanly by gas source: 江西省天然气管道有限公司 ('天然气管道公司', Phase I, sources from 川气东送/Chuan-qi-dong-song, PipeChina-Jiangxi-Gas-Group 54/46 JV) and 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司 ('管道分公司', Phase II, sources from 西气东输二线/WEP2, wholly owned by the provincial Group, formed 2016 to build out ~1,500km of remaining Phase-II network). This row's own FuelSource (West-East Gas Pipeline) places it in the WEP2-sourced bucket, i.e. plausibly a Phase-II PROVINCIAL branch operated by 管道分公司 -- NOT the PipeChina entity (国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司) currently staged as Operator/100% Owner in the sheet. (2) IDENTITY: separately, the NDRC 2023 interprovincial-tariff PDC (https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202312/P020231205363278799826.pdf, verified) and mee_2016 (MEE 2016 completion notice) both independently confirm WEP2's OWN East-section branch structure in this corridor is exactly TWO named PipeChina branches -- 南昌-上海支干线 (1016mm/10MPa/10bcm-y) and 樟树-湘潭联络线 (=P4946, 660mm/10MPa/4bcm-y) -- neither named '高安-余江'/'高安至余江'/'高余线'. No document found in this pass (exhaustion of 7 dominant_documents + 14 harvest_pool_live + targeted WebSearch) names a WEP2 branch by this name anywhere. (3) A geographically plausible but UNCONFIRMED lead: jxgajc_11456 (P5865's Zhangshu-branch completion EIA) names a '高安-鹰潭供气管道' (Gao'an-Yingtan gas supply line) as an upstream tie-in -- Yingtan City administratively contains Yujiang District (2018 county-to-district conversion), so this COULD be the same corridor as 'Gao'an-Yujiang', but no source states the equivalence and no specs are given for that line in the passing mention. (4) RULED OUT as a naming collision: qianzhan's Jiangxi-provincial Phase I trunk list separately names '高安-新余' (Gao'an-Xinyu) among 6 Phase-I trunks -- superficially similar but administratively and (per the CCXI phase/gas-source split) financially a DIFFERENT line (Phase I / Chuan-qi-dong-song-sourced, not WEP2-sourced), so this is NOT a duplicate/rename candidate for this row. NET: this is not an existence or duplication question (no recommendation to delete/merge this row -- a Gao'an-Yujiang gas corridor plausibly exists, serving real Jiangxi demand, consistent with the CCXI report's account of ~1,500km of Phase-II provincial branches built post-2016), but PipelineName (currently 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2', arguably should read as a Jiangxi-provincial-network branch WEP2-sourced rather than a WEP2 branch itself -- cf. how P4785-P4791/P5860/P5863 were already flagged) and Operator/Owner (currently PipeChina/100%, plausibly should read 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司) both look like values inherited from the wrong scope. Recommend Update pursue a document naming '高安-余江'/'高安至余江' directly (a 竣工环境保护验收 filing on the jxgajc.com/江西赣安检测技术 pattern that sourced P5865 would be the natural next search, or a 江西省天然气集团 disclosure listing 管道分公司's individual Phase-II lines by name) before changing PipelineName/Operator/Owner on the live sheet -- none of this run's findings name 高安-余江 directly, so nothing here is staged as a value change, only flagged.
